title: Efficacy of a smartphone-based cognitive behavioural therapy app for adults with mild to moderate depression: a randomized controlled trial
authors: Mueller R, Keller S, Baumgartner A, Tanaka M, Fischer L
design: Multicentre RCT, 8 Swiss primary care sites
primaryOutcome: PHQ-9 change at 12 weeks: -5.4 vs -2.2 (diff -3.2, 95% CI -4.1 to -2.3)

title: Internet-based cognitive behavioural therapy for depression: a systematic review and meta-analysis of guided vs unguided interventions
authors: Andersson G, Cuijpers P, Carlbring P, Riper H, Hedman E
design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 42 RCTs
primaryOutcome: Guided iCBT effect size d=0.78 (95% CI 0.65-0.91); unguided d=0.42

title: Cost-effectiveness of digital mental health interventions for depression: a health economic evaluation from a Swiss payer perspective
authors: Huber M, Schmid S, Wagner B, Berger T
design: Markov cohort model, Swiss OKP perspective

title: Mobile app-based cognitive behavioural therapy for depression in primary care: a pragmatic randomized controlled trial
authors: Richards D, Enriquez M, Gupta R, Vally Z
intervention: Mobile CBT app + usual care, 12 weeks
healthcareUtilisation: GP visits -1.4 per 6 months (95% CI -2.1 to -0.7)
